objects.name: Add Cost Value Column
objects.description: Multiply Quantity by Unit Cost, where Unit Cost is looked up from Item_Master.xlsx (maintained by the Costing team on SharePoint), not present in the ERP extract itself.

objects.name: Item_Master.xlsx
objects.description: Costing-team-maintained SharePoint file providing per-item Unit Cost, required to compute the Inventory dashboard's Cost Value column.

objects.name: Add Review Flag Column
objects.description: IF formula (e.g. =IF(G2>0,"Yes","No")) flagging any item with nonzero 90-plus-day aged quantity for review.

objects.name: Refresh & Publish Inventory Dashboard
objects.description: Refresh Inventory_Aging_Dashboard.pbix and publish to the Supply Chain Analytics workspace.

objects.name: Export & Email Excel to Supply Chain Director
objects.description: Because the Supply Chain Director (Arjun Mehta) doesn't use Power BI Service, export the main table as Excel and email it directly to him (CC warehouse managers) after publishing.

objects.name: Power BI Desktop October 2024+ Requirement
objects.description: A connector change in this version is required for the Revenue dashboard to refresh correctly; older versions break it.

objects.name: SharePoint (Finance Site)
objects.description: Hosts all three .pbix files (PBI Reports folder), the Revenue raw extract drop folder, and the Item_Master.xlsx costing file; also provides version history for recovery.
